topics.title: The United States and Iran Trade Fire Across the Persian Gulf
topics.note: Genuine follow-up to an ongoing US-Iran maritime confrontation. New this issue: the direct September 5 exchange in which the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US carrier and destroyer near the Strait of Hormuz (both evaded, no US casualties per CENTCOM) and the US struck three Iranian oil tankers in response.

topics.title: Britain Bans Trade With Israeli Settlements as Allies Follow
topics.note: September 8: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced an import ban on West Bank settlement goods plus sanctions on settlement-linked individuals and services; Canada and France announced parallel bans, France pushing for an EU-wide measure; Israel moved to close the UK consulate in Jerusalem; the US said it would not follow.

topics.title: Xi Jinping Courts the World Before His Washington Summit
topics.note: Xi's dense pre-summit diplomacy (state visits, multilateral summits, a meeting with Modi) ahead of a planned late-September White House state visit at Trump's invitation; agenda expected to cover trade, AI, Taiwan, the Iran conflict, and nuclear arms control after the New START lapse.
